title: unique() ignores its key argument
issue: `unique(["a", "A", "b"], key=str.lower)` returns all three items; it should return `["a", "b"]`. The key is also the only way to de-duplicate unhashable items: `unique([{"id": 1}, {"id": 1}], key=lambda d: d["id"])` currently raises `TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'`.

steps.say: I'll start with the module the issue is about.
Before changing anything I want to see what the existing tests cover.
The function accepts key but never calls it: the item itself is always used as the marker.

args.new_text: marker = key(item) if key is not None else item

steps.say: Running the tests again to confirm nothing that worked before is broken.

args.summary: The marker is now key(item) when a key is given, and the item itself otherwise.
